```{r setup}
library(MolBioR)
```

This package allow the user to quickly walk-through the central dogma in R, and includes five functions.

The first function `DNA_seq_generator` creates an arbitrary DNA sequence of a given length:

```{r}
test_DNA <- DNA_seq_generator(90)
test_DNA
```

The

```{r}
RNA_test <- DNAtoRNA(test_DNA)
RNA_test
```
